content.text: Hi, can you send ORD-1109 to my office instead? It's ul. Prosta 20, Warsaw.
Sure thing! Could you please provide the email address associated with your Northwind Goods account? This will let me verify the order and make the address change for you.

We need to verify identity first. Customer wants to change shipping address. Must ask for email, then lookup_customer, verify order belongs to them, then check order status (not shipped). Need to ask for email first.
